target_customer: Online marketplaces (and their sellers) that want to offer sellers easy advertising
problem: Individual sellers on marketplaces such as Etsy or Eventbrite struggle to run effective ads. Boostable integrated with marketplaces to auto-generate creative and run optimized Facebook campaigns, with the marketplace earning fees.
business_model: Ad management take rate shared with marketplace partners

founders.name: Selcuk Atli
founders.background_notes: Per his YC page entry; later CEO of Bunch.

founders.name: Alex Chang
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder and CTO; no other background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace API integrations plus automated Facebook ad creation and optimization; standard engineering with some hard optimization work.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace integrations helped, but marketplaces and ad platforms could build similar self-serve tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired it; Metric Collective acquired Boostable in June 2016 per aggregator listings. Etsy and others later built their own ad products, which are later entrants.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reported in October 2014 that about 10 marketplaces including OpenSky were on board, and sellers on multiple marketplaces wanted help getting sales; no spend data was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive coined name that signals the benefit; no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Boostable raised about $500K of seed in March 2014 and $3.2M more in October 2014 to add marketplaces and channels beyond Facebook. About 10 marketplaces signed on, but no later round was found, and it was acquired by Metric Collective in June 2016 on undisclosed terms. The sources do not say whether the exit was a soft landing or a success, so the cause is not public.
notes: Company website returned 503. Founded year not stated on the YC page. The March 2014 amount is 'more than $500,000' per TechCrunch via a search summary, so 500000 is a floor. Round details come from search result summaries of TechCrunch and Crowdfund Insider; those pages were not opened. The acquirer comes from Seedtable and CB Insights listings only (Seedtable fetch returned 403), so it is lightly verified; Selcuk Atli's YC bio says Metric. No dated competitor sources were found; TechCrunch notes only that sellers can already buy ads on their own.
